messages.subject: barplot horizontally
parts:
Hi,

The following code plot bars vertically. I'm wondering how to plot
bars horizontally. Could anybody show me how to do it? Thanks!

library(ggplot2)
aframe=data.frame(X=letters[1:7], Y=1:7)
p=qplot(X, Y, data=aframe, geom="bar")
ggsave(p, file='main.png')

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: 45a85351148578ad
messages.subject: RE: barplot horizontally
parts:
Hi Peng,

Try (http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/coord_flip.html):

qplot(X, Y, data=aframe, geom="bar") + coord_flip()

hth,
fernadno
